_readme: Voice design data (npcgen/voice/describe.py). Phrases are written without pronouns so they fit anyone. {adult} in a style phrase becomes ', still clearly an adult' for characters 18 or older and nothing otherwise. Voice-type presets and chips are appended to the description the model reads, except the accent chip, which goes first: an accent at the end of a long description was ignored (2026-09-24). With an accent chip picked, a preset's accent_free text replaces its text and the setting_voice phrases of setting_accents are taken out of the description, so nothing contradicts the chip.

style_voice.chibi: Small, bright, cute voice with a bouncy lift, like a cartoon mascot{adult}.
style_voice.anime: Bright, expressive delivery like an English anime dub.
style_voice.manga: Bright, expressive delivery like an English anime dub.
style_voice.cartoon: Animated and exaggerated, like a cartoon character.
style_voice.comic: Punchy and dramatic, like a comic-book character.
style_voice.pulp: Punchy and dramatic, like an old adventure serial.
style_voice.pixel: Light and playful, like a retro game character.
style_voice.pixel8: Light and playful, like a retro game character.
style_voice.voxel: Light and playful, like a video game character.

setting_voice.zombies: Raspy and strained, the voice worn ragged.

race_voice: A faint growl at the edges of the voice.
Light and airy, a little chirpy.
A slight hiss on the s sounds.
Light and airy, with a tinkling brightness.
Crisp, with a slightly synthetic edge.

voice_types.label: Valley Girl
voice_types.text: Valley-girl accent: bubbly California upspeak with a little vocal fry.
voice_types.accent_free: Bubbly and chatty, with rising upspeak and a little vocal fry.

voice_types.label: Anime heroine
voice_types.text: Bright, high, expressive anime-dub voice, energetic and earnest.

voice_types.label: Cartoon
voice_types.text: Exaggerated, bouncy cartoon voice with big comic swings in pitch.

voice_types.label: Chibi
voice_types.text: Tiny, sweet, squeaky mascot-like voice, bubbly and giggly, still an adult's.

voice_types.label: Fashion model
voice_types.text: Poised and polished: smooth, slightly breathy, relaxed and effortlessly glamorous.

voice_types.label: Pirate
voice_types.text: Rough, salty pirate voice with a West Country burr.

voice_types.label: Southern charm
voice_types.text: Warm Southern US accent, unhurried and sweet.

voice_types.label: Posh British
voice_types.text: Posh British Received Pronunciation, crisp and refined.

voice_types.label: Robot / AI
voice_types.text: Crisp, even, slightly synthetic AI voice.

voice_types.label: Peppy
voice_types.text: Peppy, loud and cheerful, bursting with energy.

voice_types.label: Shy and soft
voice_types.text: Soft, quiet and a little shy.

chips.label: American
chips.text: Speaks with a General American accent.

chips.label: British
chips.text: Speaks with a strong British accent: southern English Received Pronunciation, non-rhotic, no r sound at the ends of words, long 'ah' vowels.

chips.label: Southern US
chips.text: Speaks with a strong Southern US drawl: stretched, gliding vowels and an easy, unhurried rhythm.

chips.label: New York
chips.text: Speaks with a strong New York accent: dropped r sounds, 'coffee' as 'cawfee', quick and punchy.

chips.label: Irish
chips.text: Speaks with a strong Irish accent: a lilting, musical rhythm, soft 't' sounds and rolled r sounds.

chips.label: Scottish
chips.text: Speaks with a strong Scottish accent: rolled r sounds, short clipped vowels, a Scottish lilt.

chips.label: Australian
chips.text: Speaks with a broad Australian accent: rising ends of sentences and wide, drawn-out vowels.

chips.label: French
chips.text: A native French speaker talking in English with a strong French accent: French vowels, a dropped h, stress on the last syllable of each phrase.

chips.label: German
chips.text: A native German speaker talking in English with a strong German accent: hard consonants, w said like v, clipped precise vowels.

chips.label: Russian
chips.text: A native Russian speaker talking in English with a strong Russian accent: rolled r sounds, heavy consonants, few articles.

chips.label: Spanish
chips.text: A native Spanish speaker talking in English with a strong Spanish accent: rolled r sounds, short pure vowels, a quick rhythm.

chips.label: Italian
chips.text: A native Italian speaker talking in English with a strong Italian accent: a musical rhythm, rolled r sounds, vowels added to word endings.

chips.label: Indian
chips.text: Speaks English with a strong Indian accent: retroflex t and d sounds, an even, syllable-timed rhythm.

chips.label: Nigerian
chips.text: Speaks English with a strong Nigerian accent: even, syllable-timed rhythm and pure, open vowels.

chips.label: Jamaican
chips.text: Speaks with a strong Jamaican accent: a patois rhythm, dropped h sounds and 'th' said as 't' or 'd'.

chips.label: Japanese
chips.text: A native Japanese speaker talking in English with a strong Japanese accent: pure Japanese vowels, r and l blurred together, extra vowels after consonants, an even, syllable-timed rhythm.

take_scripts.English: Hi, I'm {name}. It's really good to meet you. I've been looking forward to this all day, so come on, tell me everything. How have you been?
take_scripts.Chinese: 你好，我是{name}。很高兴认识你。我一整天都在期待这一刻，快告诉我，你最近怎么样？
take_scripts.Japanese: こんにちは、{name}です。お会いできてうれしいです。今日はずっと楽しみにしていたんですよ。ねえ、元気でしたか？
take_scripts.Korean: 안녕하세요! 만나서 정말 반가워요. 오늘 하루 종일 이 순간을 기다렸어요. 자, 다 얘기해 주세요. 요즘 어떻게 지내요?
take_scripts.German: Hallo, ich bin {name}. Schön, dich kennenzulernen. Ich habe mich den ganzen Tag darauf gefreut, also erzähl mir alles. Wie geht es dir?
take_scripts.French: Salut, je m'appelle {name}. C'est un vrai plaisir de te rencontrer. J'attendais ce moment toute la journée, alors raconte-moi tout. Comment vas-tu ?
take_scripts.Russian: Привет, меня зовут {name}. Приятно познакомиться. Весь день думаю об этой встрече. Расскажи мне всё. Как у тебя дела?
take_scripts.Portuguese: Oi, eu sou {name}. É um prazer te conhecer. Esperei por este momento o dia todo, então me conta tudo. Como você está?
take_scripts.Spanish: Hola, soy {name}. Me alegra mucho conocerte. He esperado este momento todo el día, así que cuéntamelo todo. ¿Cómo estás?
take_scripts.Italian: Ciao, sono {name}. È un vero piacere conoscerti. Ho aspettato questo momento tutto il giorno, quindi raccontami tutto. Come stai?
